exposure: gestational weight gain (GWG) below the IOM guidelines
cohort: This study included 293 pregnancies of women with type 1 DM between 24 and 41 weeks' gestation.
finding: Gestational weight gain (GWG) above the Institute of Medicine (IOM) guidelines is associated with an increased risk of macrosomia and neonatal hyperbilirubinemia in women with type 1 diabetes mellitus.
